acceptanceCriteria: dogfood-check (or dogfood-change pass 2) prints each touched hunk below 'anchored' with its path and the CEM-V1-081 anchor rule it misses, before dogfood-seal.
A regression test binds a docs-only change with a non-anchoring citation and asserts the warning; an anchoring citation produces none.
body: Corvint 1.0.0-rc.3 (build 634), policy cem-verdict gate --predicate touched-anchored. V1-1677 (docs-only build-log entry, PR beamfall/corvint#1093, sealed CEM .corvint/changes/28ebc0eeb9e5bae7cb0684124fd195b5203cf511.cem.json) was bound with DOGFOOD_CITATIONS plan '1 AGENTS.md 54:56 specification'. dogfood-change, dogfood-check and dogfood-seal all succeeded and the PR merged. At closeout, gate run cem-verdict returned CEM_VERDICT_PREDICATE_FAILED tier-below-anchored: the one hunk is tier 'cited' (no id or path anchor, CEM-V1-081). A sealed map cannot be rewritten (decision on V1-1296), so the ticket needs a follow-up delivery commit. Expected: dogfood-change or dogfood-check reports, before seal, each touched hunk whose tier would fail the policy's touched-anchored predicate, naming the fix (cite a span that defines a requirement ID the hunk adds, or one that contains its path). Actual: the first signal is the post-merge completion refusal.
title: dogfood-change binds a citation plan whose every hunk is only 'cited', then the touched-anchored cem-verdict gate refuses at closeout with no earlier warning
